feeds.title: The Jesuit Post
feeds.description: The Jesuit Post (TJP) is an online media platform that offers a Jesuit, Catholic perspective on the contemporary world. TJP covers current events, spirituality, and pop culture from a Jesuit, Catholic perspective.

feeds.title: A Jesuit's Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Fr. Errol Fernandes - a Jesuit Priest based at the moment at the Shrine of the Infant Jesus, Mumbai.

feeds.title: Ignatian Spirituality
feeds.description: IgnatianSpirituality.com is a service of Loyola Press, a ministry of the USA Midwest Province of the Society of Jesus (Jesuits). It offers information on and experiences of Ignatian spirituality from Jesuit and Ignatian sources around the world. The blog provides pathways into the major areas of Ignatian spirituality: prayer, spiritual direction, retreats, and making good decisions.

feeds.title: The Society of Jesus
feeds.description: Latest News from The Society of Jesus, founded in 1540 by Saint Ignatius Loyola and his companions. The Jesuit mission is a mission of reconciliation, working so that women and men can be reconciled with God, with themselves, with each other, and with God's creation.

feeds.title: Jesuits Ireland
feeds.description: News, videos, podcasts, articles, book reviews, and blog: all the latest from the Irish Jesuit Province. Also directory of Jesuit works and upcoming events.

feeds.title: Jesuits in Europe
feeds.description: The Jesuit Conference of European Provincials belongs to the Society of Jesus, a Christian Catholic religious order, which works promoting faith, justice, and cooperation in dialogue with the diverse cultures of the world. Through this blog, we cover all the latest Jesuits News from Europe.

feeds.title: JRCLosAltos
feeds.description: For 95 years, The Jesuit Retreat Center of Los Altos has offered women and men space for prayer and reflection, guided by experienced retreat directors. The mission is to offer the Spiritual Exercises of St. Ignatius Loyola to all. This blog is a source to share our latest news and updates.

feeds.title: Ignatian Spirituality
feeds.description: John Predmore, S.J., is a USA East Province Jesuit and was the pastor of Jordan's English language parish. He teaches art & directs BC High's adult spiritual formation programs. Ignatian Spirituality serves the contemporary world as people strive to develop a friendship with God.

feeds.title: Jesuit Refugee Service UK
feeds.description: Blog articles from Jesuit Refugee Service (JRS) covering Interviews, Accompaniment, Prayer, Destitution, Hospitality, and Volunteering. JRS is an international Catholic organization that accompanies, serves, and advocates on behalf of refugees and other forcibly displaced persons.

feeds.title: Fr Jack SJ MD
feeds.description: A blog by a Jesuit priest of the New England Province of the Society of Jesus who entered rather late in life after practicing medicine and psychiatry for 22 years.

feeds.title: Sunday Reflections
feeds.description: A blog for Sunday Sermons and Reflections. Hosted by Mount St. Joseph, Jesuit House of Formation, Bangalore, this blog carries every week Sunday Reflections by Eugene Lobo S.J., which will help the preachers to break the Word of God. Fr. Eugene is a member of the Jesuit Province of Karnataka, India.

feeds.title: Homilies of a Jesuit
feeds.description: Latest articles related to Jesuit. Some sub-topics may include but are not limited to Christianity, Communion of Saints, Discipleship, Forgiveness, Generosity, Individualism, Metanoia, Rationalism, Stewardship, and Visitation.

feeds.title: JesuitReflections
feeds.description: It is our hope that these simple spiritual reflections will offer some food for thought. Penned by Paul Pace SJ, a Jesuit priest from the island of Malta and currently residing in Dublin, Ireland, these reflections will be brief, light and, we hope, in some way enlightening.

feeds.title: Montserrat Jesuit Retreat House
feeds.description: Montserrat Jesuit Retreat House (MJRH) offers Silent, Directed, and Special Audience retreats rooted in the Spiritual Exercises of St. Ignatius Loyola. Its mission is to bring the transforming Good News of Jesus Christ to individuals and society.

feeds.title: Jesuits in the Holy Land
feeds.description: We, the Jesuits in the Holy Land - a community of Jesuits from many different nations - are very happy to share with you our vision and our mission. May these articles serve as a springboard for encounters!

feeds.title: Jesuit Retreat House
feeds.description: Jesuit Retreat House, Oshkosh, Wisconsin, fosters Spiritual enrichment rooted in the Gospels, the Catholic tradition and the spirituality of St. Ignatius of Loyola. Our ministry is dedicated to creating a rich variety of retreat experiences and providing an atmosphere of quiet, peace and prayer in which men and women of all faiths are encouraged to discover and respond generously to God's personal invitation to wholeness and holiness.

feeds.title: United Voices | Jesuit Scholastics Blog
feeds.description: United Voices is a Jesuit Scholastics blog. This platform is run by Bombay Jesuits in the formation to share their views, thoughts, reflections and ideas.

feeds.title: Jesuits.org
feeds.description: Resources & News about the Society of Jesus, the largest Catholic religious order of brothers & priests. We are the Society of Jesus, a Roman Catholic order of priests and brothers founded half a millennium ago by the soldier-turned-mystic Ignatius Loyola.

feeds.title: Jesuit Social Services
feeds.description: Jesuit Social Services works to build a just society where all people can live to their full potential. Our mission is to stand in solidarity with those in need. Expressing a faith that promotes justice.

feeds.title: British Jesuit Archives
feeds.description: The purpose of the British Jesuit Archives is to collect, preserve and make available records concerning the Jesuits in Britain. Here, you can read about our latest news, collection highlights, and reflections.
